messages:
maria: Heads-up — we saw a partial GPU capacity degradation in eu-west affecting inference-prod. Circuit-breaker started tripping and we auto-shifted traffic; p99 spiked from ~1.2s to ~3.6s for about 30m. Opening thread to capture runbook changes and action items.

shawn: Oncall here, looking. Kube events show a wave of pod evictions starting ~2419876400; scheduler backpressure + OOMKill patterns on several retry-heavy pods. Collected node logs and will paste minimal snippet below.

shawn: ```
Mar 03 10:46:12 node-53 kubelet[1]: evicting pod inference-worker-7 due to memory.available < threshold
Mar 03 10:47:02 node-34 docker: +container restart
Mar 03 10:48:30 inference-proxy: upstream RST from 10.12.45.9:443
```

lina: Noted. We're also seeing vpc-proxy showing RST spikes and a correlated increase in failed cache warms. Looks like an overlay-network ACL flap coincident with node churn. Cache priming failed, causing more cold-starts and amplifying load.

ops-bot: alert: automatic-traffic-shift executed — weights eu-west 20% -> us-east 80% at 2419876460 (policy: default-circuit-breaker).

maria: Thanks. Immediate concerns and asks: (1) Reduce oscillation — current CB thresholds are too reactive and cause flip-flopping. Need hysteresis and cooldown. (2) Prefer pre-warming reserved capacity in-region for tiered customers instead of full cross-region shift where possible. (3) Post-incident runbook edits + checklist entries.

shawn: Agreed. Proposed soft-failover policy changes (draft):
```yaml
soft_failover_policy:
  trigger_window: 180s  # evaluate errors over 3m windows
  threshold: 8%        # require sustained error rate >8%
  consecutive_windows: 3
  cooldown: 300s        # 5m cooldown after a shift
  gradual_weights: [90,80,60,40,20] # 2m per step unless stable
  graceful_degenerate_mode: true # try low-memory model variant before full shift
```
This should stop the 1-2min flaps and give room for warm-pool spin-up.

lina: Add network detector: if RSTs > 1% across nodes for 2m -> pre-emptive warm-pool spin-up and alert infra. Also check KV cache hit-rate before allowing weight shifts; if prefix-hotness < 60% consider warming jobs for 10m.

maria: Action items (owners):
1) shawn — PR to update circuit-breaker and soft-failover policy + add graceful_degenerate_mode (PR by EOD).
2) lina — implement RST detector + KV-hit preflight check (tests + alert rules).
3) devops-sre — cost guardrails: add per-minute cross-region egress cap and an automated throttle for non-critical background jobs.
4) eng-sre team — run a dry-run of the hysteresis policy in us-west canary tomorrow and report results.

devops-sre: Note on cost impact: cross-region shift caused ~\$3.2k egress during the 30m window. Recommend runbook addition: if cross-region egress > $500/min for >10m then throttle non-critical jobs and escalate to finance oncall. I'll add telemetry for per-minute egress by flow.

maria: Add to runbook text: "If cross-region egress exceeds threshold for sustained period, trigger cost-mitigation checklist (throttle non-critical flows, enable egress caps, notify finance oncall)."

shawn: Also adding two checklist steps to incident doc: (A) check KV cache hit rate (B) verify warm-pool readiness (desired capacity and healthchecks) before initiating weight shifts. Will include quick commands for checks.

lina: One more operational safety: when performing rollback, enforce canary-weighted fallback with 10% increments + 2m cooldowns to avoid immediate re-escalation.

maria: OK — meeting: 30m postmortem tomorrow 2026-03-21 10:30 UTC to review root cause, telemetry gaps, and to sign off runbook edits. Owners: shawn (playbook PR), lina (network detectors/tests), devops-sre (cost caps + retro). ops-bot, please add calendar event and agenda.

ops-bot: Created postmortem event "eu-west partial capacity incident — postmortem" for 2026-03-21 10:30 UTC. Agenda template and owner assignments added.

shawn: PR opened (draft): https://git.internal/runs/PR-1823. Will link automated test results once the canary dry-run completes tomorrow.

maria: Thanks team — closing this thread for async status updates. Post progress here when items are done and paste links to PRs/tests.
